This '''chamber''' served as the living quarters of [[Sith Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], in [[41 ABY]]. It was decorated with [[dalsa flower]]s and many paintings by [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] artists.

After Vestara's departed, her [[Lahka Khai|mother]] kept the chamber ready for the girl to return at any time. Vestara's [[uvak]] [[Tikk]] slept in the room.
